extension.summary: يعرض معلومات مخصصة عن عملية المشغل
显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: يفتح نافذة مستقلة لمعلومات العملية. تعرض هذه النافذة تفاصيل برنامج الترميز (Codec) والفيديو والصوت الخاصة بالوسائط التي يتم تشغيلها حاليًا.
Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
Megnyit egy külön folyamatinformációs ablakot. Ez az ablak az aktuálisan lejátszott média kodek-, videó- és hangadatait jeleníti meg.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news:
v2.15.5 (Jellyfin fork) - Merge reviewed upstream refactoring, IPv6 support and additional tests. - Preserve Jellyfin, multi-box dashboards, Safari startup and programme artwork.
v2.15.4 (Jellyfin fork) - Log the first refused dashboard connection even immediately after boot, keeping connection limits and warning throttling unchanged.
v2.15.3 (Jellyfin fork) - Remove Apple TV / Infuse user cards and their dashboard polling, preserving CoreELEC cards and the Safari library-tab fix.
v2.15.2 (Jellyfin fork) - Fix empty Films, Series and History tabs when multi-box startup closes the outer stream before its first snapshot, including Safari. - Reuse the own embedded card's state without opening a duplicate stream; reject snapshots from other boxes and unconfigured senders.
v2.15.1 (Jellyfin fork) - Incorporates upstream 2.15.0 colour palettes, picker and localization. - Preserves CoreELEC user cards, per-box tokens, trusted dashboards, artwork and Infuse session cards with explicitly unconfirmed HDR10 fallback.
Upstream v2.15.0 - The colour palettes grow from 50 to 250 colours: grays and every hue from red to rose, each in a vivid and a soft family, light to dark. - The colour picker opens with the HEX tile, then the setting's default colour (marked "(Default)"), then the palette sorted by colour. - Stored colours keep their colour; older stored forms are rewritten on start-up. - The language strings are sorted by area and numbered without gaps; all translations are kept.
